# Test vocabulary (not a real vocabulary)

A tiny Athena-format vocabulary for tests. Only 196236 (Septic shock, SNOMED) is a real OMOP concept ID; every 9000xxx ID, code and relationship is made up to exercise the search: synonyms, a non-standard ICD-10-CM code mapped to a standard concept, a deprecated concept, descendants and a drug ingredient. Never use it for analysis. Real vocabularies come from athena.ohdsi.org under the user's own account and licences.
